It describes a 5-person open pilot in PD using CBD capsules 100-600 mg/day with sesame-oil vehicle for six weeks; dystonia improved 20-50% in all five, while two patients had increased hypokinesia/resting tremor above 300 mg/day (body p. 24, ref 163). Sesame oil is only carrier; measured dystonia is not pain and does not identify oil effect. Review is secondary; original paper should be followed if an independent cannabinoid context is needed.

Full archived creatine review body includes sesame oil only as vehicle/control in an ovariectomized-rat hormone/creatine FST experiment (section 2.2).
